title: The Ancient Dragon
prompt:

CHARACTER BIBLE:
Children (draw these the same way on every page):
- Elliott, age 4–5, short straight light-brown hair; big gray-blue eyes, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit
- Colette, age 2–3, brown hair in a top knot; large gray-blue eyes; soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs
Pets (draw these the same way on every page):
- Winnie, a Chihuahua–Pug mix, tan fur; upright ears; curled tail; small size

Before a massive ancient stone gate covered in carved dragon runes,
an enormous ancient dragon rests with its wings folded,
head lowered slowly toward the ground as if greeting them.
The dragon is so large its head alone fills most of the frame above the children.
Elliott stands completely still, head tilted all the way back, mouth open in awe.
Colette grabs Elliott's arm with both hands, leaning into them,
equally stunned and amazed.
Winnie sits frozen between their feet, staring straight up, ears perked forward.

GLOBAL SAFETY (IMPORTANT):
- No words, letters, symbols, or text of any kind anywhere in the image.
